features.name: Comparador price comparison app
features.summary: Create a new app folder for an Argentina-focused price comparison tool where the user enters an article and the app searches online sources to compare prices.
notes: User is in Argentina; local currency, marketplaces, and stores matter.
User clarified the app should be created as a local folder inside the current project, named comparador/.
Harvest review passed on 2026-05-14; no irresponsible scraping or fake real-source data found.

features.name: Comparador Mercado Libre source integration
features.summary: Add a real Mercado Libre Argentina source adapter to the existing comparador app using permitted API access instead of scraping.
notes: User asked for the app to work with Mercado Libre.
Mercado Libre docs list /sites/$SITE_ID/search for item search; examples use Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN.
A direct unauthenticated check from this environment returned HTTP 403, so requirements/design must handle token/configuration errors explicitly.
User agreed with the MELI_ACCESS_TOKEN environment-variable approach and paused implementation until the next session.
